name: Ondas (ONDS)
teaser: Revenue is up 13 times, mostly bought with cash and shares. At $5.27 the price assumes a 20% margin by 2029 after share-based pay, above the Bull case. Reduce, with new money waiting for $1.41.
llms: Fast-growing U.S. and Israeli drone, counter-drone and defense technology group built through at least 13 acquisitions in 2026, with about $1.4 billion of cash at mid-2026, 195 million warrants and heavy share-based pay, valued on a scenario path to 2029 operating profit after share-based pay. Bear $1.17, Base $3.13, Bull $6.77. Verdict REDUCE at $5.27 (watchlist for new money), maximum buy price $1.41.
